text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling winners can feel satisfying, but gains over my average cost are not by themselves a reason to sell; consider each stock’s outlook and role in the portfolio.","My account value can fall even while I realize profits, so assess decisions by total portfolio performance rather than the pleasure of locking in a gain.","Because losses bother me more than equal-sized gains please me, I should follow a consistent, risk-based plan instead of letting purchase prices or loss aversion drive my choices."]}
